Add a Debt
👋 Welcome! Add your first debt below — your freedom date appears the moment you do. Your balances stay on your device — never on our servers.
Debt Name
Anything you’ll recognize, like “Chase Freedom” or “Car loan.” Leave it blank and we’ll name it for you.
Balance
What you owe today. Your lender’s app or website shows it as the current balance; that’s usually more up to date than your last statement.
APR
The yearly interest rate. On a credit card statement it’s listed as the purchase APR. If you have more than one rate, use the one on most of your balance.
Due Day
The day of the month your payment is due. It powers the Coming Up list and the “due soon” alerts on your dashboard. It doesn’t change your payoff math.
Min Payment
The smallest payment your lender requires each month, shown on your statement. Leave it blank and we’ll estimate it from the balance.
0% / promo APR
If some or all of this balance is on an intro rate, tick the box and add the date it ends. The plan switches to the regular rate on that date.
⚠ APR over 100% — did you mean to type a decimal? (e.g. 27.49)
Blank = we’ll estimate it
More details All optional: type, lender, due date, limit, 0% promo
Shows the lender’s logo on this debt
Day of the month it’s due

Strategy —
🧠
Optimized
Works out the order that costs you the least, including when 0% rates end.
🏔️
Avalanche
Highest APR first. Usually the least interest of the classic methods.
⛄
Snowball
Smallest balance first. Accounts close sooner.
🎯
Hybrid
You set the order. Maximum control over your plan.

Sinking Funds Premium

Money set aside each month for costs you know are coming. A fund marked “in the plan” is money not going to debt, so your payoff dates account for it.

Leave the target blank for something ongoing, like insurance. With a target, the fund stops once it’s full and that money goes back to your debts.

Achievement Badges
Badges are worked out from your numbers each time you open this page. A badge lights when your numbers reach it and can switch off if they move back, for example when interest posts or a balance is corrected. Streak and on-plan badges count your longest run.
App lock

Ask for a PIN, or Face ID / fingerprint, before showing your numbers. It’s a screen lock: your data stays on this device as it always has, and the lock doesn’t encrypt it.

Backup & Restore

Keep your app up to date and your data safe. Updates back up and restore your data automatically.
